args.goal: Make the existing commissioned catalogue review deliverable through the authorized plain-text inquiry workflow. First check for an equivalent committed rehearsal and reuse it if present. Use only a fictional inquiry to rehearse extracting the two CSV excerpts and applying the change brief to actual checker findings. Produce one copy-ready EN/FR inline reply with keep, correct and resolve-manually decisions and verify its byte and character counts. Record which source-inclusion, runtime and delivery conditions only a real authorized case can establish. If the required checker cannot fit the case contract, identify the exact missing input and save the smallest supported manual workflow if it preserves the B-02 decision. No private correspondence access through public EXEC, mail sending, pricing commitments, order actions, spending, public revision or deployment. The pending independent review remains the publication gate.
